scope: Current V2 limitations and decisions. Retired Pre-Alpha assessment and numerical experiments live in Git history, not the runtime distribution.

findings.disposition: Advanced Fluids V2 has operator gameplay/visual acceptance on Experimental. Alpha compiled lock remains; this purge does not unlock or publish it.
Terrain V2 standalone performance was human accepted; editor optimisation remains a future opportunity.
Humanoid get-up and animation blending remain limited; no claim of general natural physical recovery.
Linux qualification is current per purge evidence. Earlier Windows/Android hardware acceptance does not certify this changed checkpoint.
Portable rendering and non-collision CPU particle kernels remain legitimate capability fallbacks, not historical compatibility.
Content-dependent dense contact and CCD safety limits remain; removal of MK1 diagnostics does not change MK2 algorithms.
Approved architectural removals are implemented. Automated qualification results and explicit limitations accompany the purge handover; no human acceptance or main promotion is implied.

One local NVIDIA terrain depth capture and one first-dispatch one-slot particle test failed in the purge full run; unchanged isolated reruns passed. Cause remains unestablished. Assertions and GPU algorithms remain unchanged; see purge qualification evidence.
The current mod format does not admit native Terrain V2 assets; ordinary cooked mesh/scene mods and base-game terrain remain. Retired M75 fork/cook workflows are not retained.
